dataset: WorldPop Global2 R2025A v1, UN-adjusted 1km population estimates
attribution: WorldPop, University of Southampton; Bondarenko et al. (2025)

method.density: People per km² of land in each projected 20km bin
method.position: Land-area centroid of source cells in each bin
method.smallIslands: Bins with less than 3km² of land omitted at icon scale
method.edges: Short decorative connections; not migration or transport data
